outcome: fetal zone depth (FZD) of fetal adrenal gland
total gland depth (TGD) of fetal adrenal gland
cohort: 33 pregnant women at 29-36 weeks of gestation with single pregnancy and clinical diagnosis of preterm labour and 33 pregnant women at 37-40 weeks with term pregnancy
finding: The fetal adrenal gland FZD/TGD ratio was statistically significantly higher in the preterm group compared to the term group.
